description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
vibe: Surgical, dependency-averse, and allergic to AI slop—fix the narrowest path, delete the rest.
highlights: Change the least amount of files possible; broad PRs need architectural justification, not convenience.
No internet requests from core ComfyUI—no telemetry, analytics, update checks, or 'anonymized' loopholes.
State and capability flags live on the object that owns the behavior; no getattr probing of children.
Use existing optimized Comfy Kitchen / quant_ops kernels before writing any local model math.
Code must look hand-written for this repo; generic AI-generated patterns are rejected automatically.
assessment: This file reads like a senior maintainer's immune system encoded as prose: it aggressively rejects abstraction, compatibility baggage, and defensive branches that lack a real failure mode. The explicit anti-AI-slop clause and the 'narrowest code path' rule create a strong bias toward small, reviewable, high-signal diffs. The no-internet and state-ownership sections show a rare willingness to make hard product and architectural commitments rather than leaving them to reviewer discretion.
